name: gitpulse
$comment: forge↔project contract config for gitpulse — a creds-free git-analytics CLI + (later) a local dashboard. Mirrors the mdtoc reference shape but with more surface: real git-log parsing, aggregation, churn/ownership, a rendered dashboard, and export. Quality gate = the OFFLINE node:test unit suite; the acceptance gate runs the BUILT CLI against a deterministic temp git-repo fixture and reads back its output. No external credentials — the 'live evidence' is a local process (CLI stdout now; an HTTP dashboard once milestone 3 lands).
northStar: A dependency-free CLI + dashboard that turns a git repo's history into honest engineering analytics: commits, churn, ownership, hotspots.
instructions: Keep runtime dependencies at ZERO — node builtins only; tsx/typescript are the sole dev deps. Make the implementation satisfy the tests as written; never edit a test to make it pass. Keep source files small and feature-organised (immutable returns; validate argv/HTTP input at the boundary). Git access goes through src/git.ts (execFileSync with -C <repo>); analytics aggregation stays PURE and unit-tested. Acceptance fixtures build a deterministic temp git repo with fixed GIT_AUTHOR_DATE/names and assert via a read-back of the BUILT CLI's (or dashboard's) output, using non-default sentinel values. Record each initiative's plan + demo under forge/history/<initiative-id>/ so the repo carries a browsable build record; project skills live under .forge/skills/.
$acceptance_gate_comment: Creds-free acceptance tier (contract C7-as-creds-free). `match` identifies the live-vs-real gate by the `acceptance` token in a WI's quality_gate_cmd (`npm run acceptance`). required:true forces the PM to emit ≥1 WI whose gate runs the acceptance suite, so a behaviour change is always proven against the BUILT artifact (CLI/dashboard), not just units. requires_env is empty — gitpulse is creds-free.
$standing_work_item_acs_comment: Static testing invariants forge appends to EVERY work item (contract A2/C7/C9). Encodes the read-back + non-default-fixture + zero-dep discipline as standing ACs.
standing_work_item_acs: Acceptance read-back: the change is exercised by `npm run acceptance`, which builds a deterministic temp git repo (fixed commit dates/authors/files via GIT_AUTHOR_DATE + env) and asserts the BUILT artifact's output (CLI stdout, or the dashboard's HTTP response) reads back the expected analytics. The WI that proves a behaviour change MUST set its quality_gate_cmd to the acceptance command and update the EXPECTED constants in test/acceptance/run.ts in lock-step.

Non-default fixtures (C9): every field under test carries a distinctive, non-default sentinel value (a named author, a known churn count, a specific file path) and edge cases (a merge commit, a binary file's `-` numstat, a renamed file) so analytics that silently drop or miscount real data are caught by the read-back.

Quality gate stays fast + green: `npm test` (node:test) is deterministic, creds-free, sub-second, and PURE (no git spawning in units — parse/aggregate functions are tested against fixtures). It must fail before the work exists and pass only when the behaviour is correct.

Zero runtime dependencies: node builtins only (tsx/typescript are the sole dev deps). Docs + changelog current: a behaviour change is not done until README/docs describe it and a `## [Unreleased]` CHANGELOG.md entry is drafted (the release-finalizer promotes it at pre-merge).

demo.$shape_comment: `cli-diff` for the CLI milestones — the change is shown by running the CLI and capturing its output; once the dashboard lands (milestone 3) a browser/harness demo over the local server is appropriate. The demo command runs the creds-free acceptance driver with --demo, which writes captured evidence (the real generated analytics report) into forge/history/<initiative>/demo/.

demoProcess.text: Run `npm run demo` to build a deterministic fixture git repo, execute the built gitpulse CLI against it, and capture the real generated analytics report.
Read back the captured report against the expected sentinel values — the total commit count, the top author + their commit count, and the date range must all hold for the fixture repo.
Attach forge/history/<initiative-id>/demo/pulse-capture.md (command + captured report + read-back result) to the PR as the demo evidence.

$releaseProcess_comment: Release contract C10. In-cycle: keep docs (README/roadmap) current and draft a `## [Unreleased]` CHANGELOG entry. Pre-merge: the release-finalizer bumps the version in package.json + promotes the draft. Tag + GitHub release are CI's job (.github/workflows/release.yml, installed from studio/starters).

steps.text: Update README.md and roadmap.md so the documented CLI/dashboard surface matches the merged behaviour (commands, flags, examples).
Draft a changelog entry under `## [Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md describing the change.
Bump the semantic version in package.json to match the promoted changelog heading.
